test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

Some children surprisingly __take on__ their grandparents in appearance.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**take after**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Take after**" means to resemble or have similar traits to someone, usually a family member.
 
• In this sentence, "**Take after**" is the correct form to express the idea that children resemble their grandparents in appearance or have similar traits.
 
• Grammatically, "**take on**" is not appropriate in this context as It does not convey the same meaning as "take after"
 
• So, the proposed substitution "take after" is the most appropriate choice to convey the intended meaning of the sentence, indicating that some children resemble their grandparents in appearance.

Therefore the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence**: *Some children surprisingly take after__ their grandparents in appearance.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Taking after**" is a gerund phrase and doesn't fit well in this sentence.
 
• "**Take later**" does not make sense in this context and is grammatically incorrect.
